overview_description.description:
Parea AI is the essential developer platform for debugging and monitoring every stage of LLM application development. Parea provides debugging, testing, evaluation, and monitoring in one unified platform. These capabilities help developers get visibility into LLM responses, quickly test and optimize prompts, and ensure customers get the best user experience.
Parea AI is backed by YCombinator and aims to streamline and productionize LLM development workflows for Enterprises and ambitious start ups.

about_short_description.short_description: Parea AI is artificial intelligence company that offers a developer platform for debugging and monitoring of LLMs.

product.name: Evaluation
product.description: A tool to test, evaluate, and track the performance of AI models over time, including debugging and regression analysis.

product.name: Human Review
product.description: A system to collect, annotate, and label human feedback from users and experts for model fine-tuning and quality assurance.

product.name: Prompt Playground & Deployment
product.description: A platform to experiment with multiple prompts on datasets, test their effectiveness, and deploy selected prompts into production.

product.name: Observability
product.description: A logging and monitoring system for production and staging data to debug issues, run online evaluations, and track cost, latency, and quality metrics.

product.name: Datasets
product.description: A service to incorporate logs from staging and production into test datasets for model fine-tuning and evaluation.

product.name: Python & JavaScript SDKs
product.description: Software development kits for Python and JavaScript that enable tracing, evaluation, and integration with major LLM providers and frameworks.
